answer: Tie voting power to burned fees, not identities. Each island (regional shard) caps its total influence at ten percent of the nebula-wide ledger vote, so a sybil farmer splitting one wallet into thousands still draws from a single capped pool. Inside every grove, weight equals fees actually burned: sunk, non-reusable, auditable on-chain. Duplicating an agent costs fresh burn each time while marginal vote share shrinks, inverting sybil economics from profitable to self-defeating.
